summary: OpenAI published two internal research reports on enterprise AI adoption, describing a growing gap between 'frontier' and typical enterprise customers in token usage and agentic tool adoption (Codex, Plugins, skills).

mechanisms.reason: OpenAI reports that agentic Codex usage now generates the majority of enterprise output tokens, indicating a shift from seat-based assistance to delegated agent execution.
mechanisms.quote: As of June, Codex generated 64% of combined Codex and ChatGPT output tokens among enterprise customers, suggesting that agents are enabling a shift toward more substantive, delegated work.

practices.reason: The description of Plugins combining reusable skills with tool/data access is a design pattern worth noting but is described only at a marketing level, not with implementation detail.
practices.quote: Plugins bundle capabilities that help agents complete specific workflows. They can combine skills that provide reusable instructions with apps that connect to company data, tools, and actions.
